subject: Field study on the cancellation paragraph in your FAQ
body:
Your cancellation FAQ says you don't always see voicemails or emails right away and that every minute counts. A cancellation seen late is a seat that goes out empty instead of resold. The study's first build is a plain auto reply carrying your own sentence back and there's no AI in it.

https://alaskaaihq.com/awesomeproposal/north-country-charters/

No strings. If it's useful we're here.

Talon at Alaska AI
title_note: General business inbox, not a personal address. The site publishes titles for Brian Ritchie (Owner and Captain of The Irish) and Kathy Brennan (co-owner and office manager). Nobody else may be given a title.
opens_on: Their own cancellation FAQ paragraph, which tells guests the office does not always see voicemails or emails right away and that every minute counts.
lead_critic: ship on round 2. Round 1 was rejected on three counts, a grafted closing that borrowed Talon's words while keeping the imperative he deletes, a third sentence that had been drafted three runs running to three different companies, and a subject carrying the company name like a merge field. All three rewritten.
